content:
Formula: Euler Polyhedral Characteristic
Exact Expression: \chi = V - E + F = 2 - 2g
Definitions: Topological invariant characterizing the topological space shape or structure regardless of bending or stretching.
Derivation/Reference: Leonhard Euler (1758); Henri Poincare generalized to higher dimensions (1895)
Example: Cube: V=8, E=12, F=6 -> chi = 8 - 12 + 6 = 2 (genus g = 0 sphere topology)
Domain: topology
Assumptions: Finite CW-complex or closed 2-manifold
Common Errors: Applying sphere formula V - E + F = 2 to toroidal manifolds (genus 1 where chi = 0)
subject: Euler Polyhedral Characteristic
